newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber soft, SIR5 stable.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber soft, SIR5 stable.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were weak in late trading on Thursday despite previous deals in Palembang, dealers said.
"The market stayed quiet after deals in Palembang late on Wednesday. Some enquiries were heard from Europe and the U.S. but no deals have been done yet," one dealer in Jakarta said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November were at 55.50-56.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.25-55.75 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang. They were at 55.00-55.50 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said U.S. firms were heard buying November delivery SIR20 at 55.25 cents/lb late on Wednesday.
Another Jakarta-based dealer said SIR5 remained stable at 57.00 to 58.00 cents/lb fob Medan for October/November shipments.
Latex dealers said prices remained firm on a deal to ship between October and November around 4,000 tonnes of wet latex to Germany at 93 U.S. cents/kg following previous deals at 91.00.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
